title: Validate dark cafeteria flashlight orbit isolation
objective: Review the completed dark-map orbit validation run and determine whether it resolves the residual scene-off brightness/flicker issue for the four orbit render conditions.
instructions: Inspect the rendered artifacts, metadata, luma summary, and dark-map creation report for examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map.

Compare against the prior failure mode: scene_off_flashlight_off was bright/residual, scene_off_flashlight_on appeared scene-lit/flickery/accumulating, and saved outputs disagreed with expected scene-off semantics.
Verify all four settings have rgb.mp4, depth_meters_viridis.mp4, metadata.json, and coherent luma diagnostics.

Check whether scene_off_flashlight_off is truly dark, whether scene_off_flashlight_on has only localized flashlight contribution, whether scene-on settings remain lit, and whether any output still shows progressive exposure/brightness accumulation.
Do not change product code. This is validation only.
constraints: Do not launch a long rerender unless absolutely necessary; prefer inspecting existing output files and metadata.
expected_outputs: A concise verdict: pass/fail/partial, with concrete evidence and any remaining risk.
If failing or partial, identify the next best handoff: Builder, Experimenter, or Scout, and why.
definition_of_done: Validated artifact completeness and luma/visual behavior for all four render settings.
Reported specific file paths and metrics used as evidence.
